titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Secret of the Ark and the King's Dance (ch. 53)
part: ch. 53 — The Secret of the Ark and the King's Dance
about: At Gaza and in Egypt the escort marvel that a thirteen-day road was crossed in one day without weariness; at the Takkaze they set down the carts, dismiss the crowd and tell their king, under a vow of silence, that the Ark has come with them by God's will, not theirs. Azarias sends for the Ark to be dressed, and the king, at the thought of seeing Zion, dances like David before it.

sentences.t: ፶፫ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተውህበ ፡ ሰረገላ ፡ ለኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: 53. Where it-was-given chariot to-Ethiopia
sentences.i: Chapter 53: Where a cart was given to Ethiopia
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ 'where / at the point where' + ተውህበ 'was given' (passive stem ተ-, from ወሀበ 'give'; the same stem as ዘወሀባ in the next unit). ሰረገላ 'chariot, cart' is the vehicle that carried the company in the previous part. ለኢትዮጵያ ለ- 'to'. The heading points to the journey home through Egypt (the cart motif returns in the next units).

sentences.t: ወበኀበ ፡ ኀደሩሰ ፡ ጋዛ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እሙ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ዘወሀባ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ትመጽእ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ለንግሥተ ፡ ኢትዮጽያ ።
sentences.l: And-at-the-place they-dwelt-indeed Gaza, she city-of mother-of the-king which-he-gave-her when she-came to-him king Solomon to-queen-of Ethiopia
sentences.i: And at the place where they stayed was Gaza, the city of the king's mother, which King Solomon gave to the queen of Ethiopia when she came to him.
sentences.n: ወበኀበ ወ- 'and' + በ- 'at' + ኀበ 'place where'; ኀደሩሰ 'they dwelt' (ኀደረ) with the emphatic particle -ሰ. ሀገረ እሙ ለንጉሥ is a construct chain 'city-of mother-of the-king': 'the king's mother' is Queen Makeda, and 'the king' is her son Menelik. ዘወሀባ 'which he gave her' (ዘ- + ወሀበ + -ኣ 'her', written -ባ). ሶበ 'when'. The word order puts ንጉሥ ሰሎሞን after ትመጽእ ኀቤሁ 'she came to him', so 'to him' = Solomon. ኢትዮጽያ is Bezold's spelling here (elsewhere ኢትዮጵያ). ጋዛ Gaza (as printed).

sentences.t: ወእምህየ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ደወለ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እንተ ፡ ስማ ፡ ምስሪን ፤
sentences.l: And-from-there they-arrived in-one day into regions-of Egypt which name-her Mesrin
sentences.i: From there they reached, in a single day, a district of Egypt whose name is Mesrin.
sentences.n: በጽሑ 'they arrived' (በጽሐ). በአሐቲ ዕለት 'in one day' (አሐቲ feminine 'one', agreeing with ዕለት). ደወለ ግብጽ 'regions-of Egypt' (construct); ደወል 'district, region' (?). እንተ ስማ 'which her-name (is)': እንተ is the feminine relative agreeing with the district. ምስሪን is printed as a name, evidently Mesrin, connected with Egypt's Hebrew-derived name Miṣrayim (?). The one-day arrival is the first of the miracle-notes (cf. the previous part's cart ride).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ርእዩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኀያላነ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ በአሐቲ ፡ ዕለት ፡ በጽሑ ፡ ምሕዋረ ፡ ፲ወ፫ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ወኢደክሙ ፡ ወኢርኅቡ ፡ ወኢጸምኡ ፡ ኢሰብእ ፡ ወኢእንስሳ ፡ ወኵሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘሶቤ ፡ ጸግቡ ፡ ወሰትዩ ፡ አእመሩ ፡ ወአምኑ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኀይል ፡ ከመ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነት ፡ ዛቲ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-saw sons-of mighty-ones-of Israel that in-one day they-arrived journey-of 13 day, and-not they-tired and-not they-hungered and-not they-thirsted neither man nor beast, and-all-of-them like those-of-the-moment (?) they-were-full and-drank, they-knew and-they-believed those sons-of might that from-with God was this
sentences.i: When the sons of the mighty ones of Israel saw that they had covered in one day a journey of thirteen days, and that they were not tired, hungry or thirsty, neither man nor beast, but all of them were as if they had just eaten their fill and drunk, those sons of strength knew and believed that this had come from God.
sentences.n: A long unit built from one ሶበ 'when' clause and a ከመ 'that' clause. ደቂቀ ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'sons-of mighty-ones-of Israel' (construct chain; ኀያላን plural of ኀያል 'mighty'). ምሕዋረ is the accusative of ምሕዋር 'way, journey', followed by ፲ወ፫ ዕለት, the numeral ፲ወ፫ 'thirteen' (spoken as in the glossary convention, ዐሠርቱ ወሠላስ... 'ten and three'). The three negatives ወኢደክሙ ወኢርኅቡ ወኢጸምኡ ('and-not they-tired / hungered / thirsted'; perfects of ደከመ, ርኅበ, ጸምአ) are followed by ኢሰብእ ወኢእንስሳ 'neither man nor beast'. ከመ ዘሶቤ 'like (those) of the moment' (?): ሶቤ 'at once, then'; the sense is 'as ones who have just eaten' (?). ጸግቡ 'were sated' (ጸገበ). አእመሩ 'they knew' (አእመረ) and አምኑ 'they believed' (perfect). ደቂቀ ኀይል 'sons-of strength / might' is the term for the young men of Israel who escort the Ark. እምኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'from with God'. The pattern 'sign of divine power on the journey' recurs in these chapters.

sentences.t: ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለንጉሦሙ ፡ ናውርድ ፡ ሰረገላተ ፡ እስመ ፡ በጻሕነ ፡ ማየ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ተከዚ ፡ እንተ ፡ ትወርድ ፡ እምኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወትሰቂ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ግብጽ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-said-to-him to-their-king let-us-bring-down chariots for we-have-arrived waters-of Ethiopia, this she Takkaze which she-descends from-Ethiopia and-gives-drink river-of Egypt
sentences.i: They said to their king, 'Let us bring the carts down, for we have reached the waters of Ethiopia: this is the Takkaze, which flows down from Ethiopia and waters the river of Egypt.'
sentences.n: ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (ይቤ + -ልዎ, the plural form: ይቤልዎ 'they say to him'); the king is Menelik, here simply ንጉሡ. ናውርድ 'let us bring down' (causative አውረደ of ወረደ 'descend'; the ን- jussive, 'let us'). ሰረገላተ 'chariots, carts' is the broken plural. እስመ 'for'. በጻሕነ 'we have arrived' (1pl of በጽሐ). ተከዚ is the Takkaze (Tekezé), the Ethiopian river that runs to the Nile; ዛቲ ይእቲ 'this (is) she'. ትሰቂ 'it gives to drink / waters' (causative of ሰትየ), ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river-of Egypt', the Nile. Egypt's border here is crossed on the way into the Ethiopian watershed.

sentences.t: ወአውረዱ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ ህየ ፡ ወተከሉ ፡ ደባትሪሆሙ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-brought-down their-chariots there and-they-planted their-tents (?)
sentences.i: So they brought their carts down there and pitched their tents.
sentences.n: አውረዱ 'they brought down' (causative, as in the last unit). ተከሉ 'they planted' (ተከለ) is the idiom for pitching tents. ደባትሪሆሙ 'their ደባትር' is a plural with the possessive -ሆሙ; I take ደባትር as 'tents, pavilions' (?) from context. This unit ends at the single ፨ the source prints mid-paragraph, a stronger stop than ።.

sentences.t: ወሖሩ ፡ ኅቡረ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ኀይል ፡ ወሰደዱ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ለንጉሦሙ ፡ ንንግርከኑ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ትክል ፡ ተዐግሦ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-went together sons-of might and-they-sent-away all peoples, and-they-said-to-him to-their-king shall-we-tell-you word if you-are-able you-bear-with-it
sentences.i: The sons of strength went off together and sent away all the people. And they said to their king, 'May we tell you something, if you are able to bear it?'
sentences.n: ወሖሩ 'and they went' (ሖረ). ኅቡረ 'together' (accusative adverb). ሰደዱ 'they sent away, dismissed' (ሰደደ). ኵሎ አሕዛበ 'all peoples' (ኵሎ + accusative plural of ሕዝብ). ንንግርከኑ 'shall we tell you?' (ንነግር 'we tell' + -ከ 'you' + the question particle -ኑ; the second ን is part of the form's spelling). ለእመ 'if'; ትክል 'you are able' (ክህለ); ተዐግሦ 'you endure / are patient with it' (ተዐገሰ + -ኦ 'it', written -ሦ) (?). The secret is the Ark's presence; the king is asked to swear silence first.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ እወ ፡ እክል ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ትቤሉኒ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሞትየ ፡ ኢያወፅእ ፡ ወኢያወሥእ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-them yes I-am-able; and-if you-tell-me until day-of my-death not he-brings-out and-not he-brings-in (?)
sentences.i: He said to them, 'Yes, I can. And whatever you tell me, until the day of my death I will not bring it out or let it in (?).'
sentences.n: ወይቤሎሙ 'and he said to them'. እወ 'yes'. እክል 'I am able'. ወለእመ ትቤሉኒ 'and if you tell me' (ትቤሉ 'you say to' + -ኒ 'me'). እስከ ዕለተ ሞትየ 'until day-of my-death' (construct). ኢያወፅእ ወኢያወሥእ 'he does not bring out / does not bring in' (?): a paired negation (ያወፅእ causative of ወጽአ 'go out'; ያወሥእ is a causative of the verb 'enter'? (?)); the sense is a vow of secrecy. Dillmann is unavailable, hence the hedge.

sentences.t: ወይቤልዎ ፡ ወረደት ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ እምሰማይ ፡ ወተውህበት ፡ በሲና ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወኮነት ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ለዘመደ ፡ አዳም ፡ እምነ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘርአ ፡ እሴይ ፡ ወነዋ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-they-said-to-him: she-descended sun from-heaven and-she-was-given at-Sinai to-Israel and-she-became salvation for-kin-of Adam from Moses until seed-of Jesse, and-behold-her with-you by-will-of God
sentences.i: They said to him: 'The sun came down from heaven and was given on Sinai to Israel, and she became salvation for the race of Adam, from Moses until the seed of Jesse; and now, behold, she is with you, by the will of God.
sentences.n: ፀሐይ 'sun' is feminine here (ወረደት, ተውህበት, ኮነት all with feminine -ት): the 'sun' is Zion, the Ark (ታቦት), in the book's Zion/Ark theology; her descent from heaven and gift at Sinai echo the giving of the Law (Exodus 19). ዘመደ አዳም 'kin-of Adam' (construct). እምነ ሙሴ እስከ ዘርአ እሴይ 'from Moses to the seed of Jesse', i.e. to David and his descendants (Jesse was David's father; Solomon is of that seed). ነዋ 'behold her' (ነያ, as in unit 13). ኀቤከ 'with you', በፈቃደ 'by the will-of' (construct). The speech continues through unit 18.

sentences.t: ወአኮ ፡ እምኀቤነ ፡ ዘተገብረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ አላ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአኮ ፡ እምኀቤነ ፡ ዘተገብረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ አላ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ ኬንያሃ ፡ ወገባሪሃ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ከመዝ ፤
sentences.l: And-not from-with-us that-which-was-done this but by-will-of God, and-not from-with-us that-which-was-done this but by-will-of ኬንያሃ (?) and-her-maker it-was thus
sentences.i: It was not from us that this was done, but by the will of God. It was not from us that this was done, but by the will of ኬንያሃ (?) and her maker; so it came to be.
sentences.n: ወአኮ 'and not' (negative of the noun/predicate). እምኀቤነ 'from with-us' (እም- + ኀበ + -ነ). ዘተገብረ 'that which was done' (ተገብረ, passive of ገብረ 'do'). አላ 'but'. The sentence ወአኮ እምኀቤነ ... በፈቃደ repeats verbatim in the source, and I keep it as printed (the repeat seems to have come from a copyist, with the second run ending differently). ኬንያሃ is unclear to me (?): perhaps 'her ... ' with the -ሃ 'her' of the next word ወገባሪሃ 'and her maker' (ገባሪ 'maker', -ሃ 'her'); I leave it as a hedged unknown. ኮነ ከመዝ 'it was thus'.

sentences.t: ንሕነ ፡ ፈቀድነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ተሰናአውነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አሠነየ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ተናገርነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ገብረ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ኀለይነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ መከረ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ንቤ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ሠምረ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ አንጸርነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አርትዐ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ኀለይነ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አጽደቀ ፤
sentences.l: We we-wished and-God he-accomplished; we we-made-ready (?) and-God he-made-good; we we-spoke-together and-God he-did; we we-thought and-God he-counselled; we we-say and-God he-was-pleased; we we-looked and-God he-made-straight; we we-thought and-God he-confirmed
sentences.i: We wished, and God accomplished; we prepared (?), and God made it good; we conferred, and God acted; we reflected, and God took counsel; we spoke, and God was pleased; we looked on, and God set it right; we thought, and God made it firm.
sentences.n: A deliberate string of paired clauses: ንሕነ 'we' + a 1pl perfect (-ነ), then ወእግዚኣብሔር 'and God' + a 3sg perfect. Pairs: ፈቀድነ / ፈጸመ 'wished / completed'; ተሰናአውነ / አሠነየ 'made ourselves ready (?) / made good' (አሠነየ causative of ሠነየ 'be fair'); ተናገርነ / ገብረ 'spoke / did'; ኀለይነ / መከረ 'thought / counselled' (ኀለየ, መከረ); ንቤ / ሠምረ 'we say (imperfect, written ንቤ) / was pleased'; አንጸርነ / አርትዐ 'we looked / made straight' (አርትዐ, causative of ርትዐ 'be upright'); ኀለይነ / አጽደቀ 'we thought / confirmed'. The same human/divine contrast is the point: human intention, divine accomplishment. Some readings are uncertain (?), especially ተሰናአውነ and ንቤ.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ኪያከ ፡ ኀረየ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሀገርከ ፡ ሠምረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትኩን ፡ ላእከ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወይእቲ ፡ ትኩንከ ፡ መርሐ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ለከ ፡ ወለዘርእከ ፡ እምድኅሬከ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ዐቀብከ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወገበርከ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፤
sentences.l: And-now you chose-him God and-your-land he-was-pleased-with, that you-be minister to-Zion holy heavenly, Ark-of law-of to-God, and-she she-be-to-you guide forever, to-you and-to-your-seed after-you, if you-keep his-commandments and-you-do his-will for-God your-God
sentences.i: And now God has chosen you and been pleased with your land, so that you may be a servant of holy, heavenly Zion, the Ark of the law of God; and she will be a guide to you for ever, to you and to your descendants after you, if you keep his commandments and do the will of the Lord your God.
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (-ኒ emphatic). ኪያከ ኀረየ 'you he chose' (ኪያ- + -ከ puts the object first for emphasis; ኀረየ 'choose'). ከመ ትኩን 'that you be' (subjunctive), ላእከ 'minister, servant' in the accusative (?) with ለጽዮን 'to/of Zion' (the Ark, called ጽዮን here, with 'holy' and 'heavenly'). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'Ark-of law-of God' (construct chains; ለ- doing the work of the genitive after a possessed noun, ሕጉ 'his law'). ትኩንከ መርሐ 'she will be to-you a guide' (መርሐ accusative). ዘርእከ 'your seed' (ዘርእ + -ከ). ለእመ 'if' + ዐቀብከ 'you keep' (ዐቀበ), ትእዛዞ 'his commandments' (-ኦ 'his', written -ዞ), ገበርከ 'you did/do'. Deuteronomy-style covenant condition, tied here to the Ark and to Menelik's house.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኢትክል ፡ አንተ ፡ አግብኦታ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ፈቀድከ ፡ ወአቡከ ፡ ነሢኦታ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ እስመ ፡ ለሊሃ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈቀደት ፡ ወኢትትነሣእ ፡ እመንበራ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢፈቀደት ፡ ለሊሃ ፤
sentences.l: For not you-are-able you returning-her if you-wish, and-your-father taking-her if he-wished; for herself she-goes to-where she-wished, and-not she-is-lifted her-throne if not she-wished herself
sentences.i: For you could not send her back if you wished, and your father could not take her if he wished; for she herself goes where she pleases, and her seat is not lifted up unless she herself pleases.
sentences.n: አግብኦታ and ነሢኦታ are verbal nouns with the object suffix: 'bringing-her-back', 'taking-her' (አግብአ causative of ገብአ 'return'; ነሥአ 'take'); the second has no 'cannot' of its own, so ኢትክል 'you cannot' covers both ('and your father' = Solomon). ለሊሃ 'herself'. ተሐውር 'she goes' (ሖረ). ኀበ ፈቀደት 'to where she wished' (feminine verb, the Ark). ወኢትትነሣእ እመንበራ 'and her seat is not lifted' (passive ተነሥአ + እመንበር 'throne, seat', here the Ark's own seat; the ምስካይ 'refuge' theme follows). The Ark moves by its own will: key to the book's theology.

sentences.t: ወነያ ፡ ይእቲእግዝእትነ ፡ እምነወመድኀኒትነ ፡ ጸወንነ ፡ ወምስካይነ ፡ ክብርነ ፡ ወመርሶ ፡ መድኀኒትነ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ናሰምክ ፡ ባቲ ።
sentences.l: And-behold-her she our-lady, our-mother and-our-salvation, our-fortress and-our-refuge, our-glory and-harbour-of our-salvation for those we-lean on-her
sentences.i: And here she is, our Lady, our mother and our salvation, our fortress and our refuge, our glory and the harbour of our salvation, for us who lean upon her.
sentences.n: Two source words are fused in print: ይእቲእግዝእትነ = ይእቲ 'she' + እግዝእትነ 'our lady' (እግዝእት + -ነ); እምነወመድኀኒትነ = እምነ 'our mother' (እም + -ነ) + ወ- 'and' + መድኀኒትነ 'our salvation' (መድኀኒት + -ነ). I split them so. ነያ 'behold her' (see unit 8). Each noun takes the 1pl possessive -ነ: ጸወንነ 'our fortress', ምስካይነ 'our refuge', ክብርነ 'our glory', መርሶ 'harbour-of' (construct). ለእለ ናሰምክ ባቲ 'for those who lean on her': ሰመከ 'lean, rely' with በ- + -ኣ 'her'. This is the book's Marian-style language for Zion as Lady, applied to the Ark.

sentences.t: ወቀጸቦ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ለኤልምያኖስ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ሖር ፡ አሠንያ ፡ ወአልብሳ ፡ ለእግዝእትነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይርአያ ፡ ንጉሥነ ።
sentences.l: And-he-called-aside (?) Azarias Elmeyas and-he-said-to-him: go, adorn-her and-clothe-her our-lady, that they-see-her our-king
sentences.i: Azarias took Elmeyas aside (?) and said to him, 'Go, adorn her and clothe our Lady, so that our king may see her.'
sentences.n: አዛርያስ Azarias is the son of Zadok the priest (see ch. 51–52); ኤልምያኖስ is the name as printed, with ለ- marking the object. ወቀጸቦ is unclear: 'beckoned / struck / called' (?); I take 'called aside' from the sense. ሖር 'go' (imperative), አሠንያ 'make her beautiful' (አሠነየ + -ኣ 'her'), አልብሳ 'clothe her' (causative of ለብሰ + -ኣ), as in the garment instructions of ch. 51–52. ከመ ይርአያ 'that he may see her'. ንጉሥነ 'our king' is Menelik, spoken of in the third person.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተናገረ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ደንገፀ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ወአንበረ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ወአስተንፈሰ ፡ ሠለስተ ፡ እስትንፋሰ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አማንኑ ፡ እግዚኦ ፡ ትዜከረነ ፡ በሣህልከ ፡ ለግዱፋን ፡ እለ ፡ መነንከ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ከመ ፡ እርአያ ፡ ለማኅደርከ ፡ ንጽሕት ፡ እንተ ፡ በሰማያት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ሰማያዊት ፤
sentences.l: And-this when he-said Azarias he-was-startled king David, and-he-placed both-of-them his-hands upon his-heart, and-he-breathed three breaths; and-he-said: in-truth? O-Lord, you-remembered-us in-your-mercy, the-rejected (?) whom you-set-apart (?) people, that I-may-see-her for-your-dwelling pure which in-the-heavens Zion holy heavenly
sentences.i: When Azarias had said this, King David was startled; he laid both his hands upon his heart and drew three breaths. And he said: 'Is it true, O Lord, that you have remembered us in your mercy, us outcasts (?) whom you set apart (?) from the people, so that I should see your pure dwelling, which is in the heavens, holy heavenly Zion?
sentences.n: ወዘንተ 'and this' (object, with ዘ-). ንጉሥ ዳዊት: the book calls the young king David, his regnal name; here this is Menelik, as the context shows (the king whose men address him, whose father is Solomon, and whom unit 20 compares to 'David, father of his father'). ደንገፀ 'was startled, shaken' (ደንገፀ). ክልኤሆን 'both of them' (feminine plural). አስተንፈሰ 'he breathed' (causative stem). አማንኑ 'in truth?' (አማን 'truly' + -ኑ). እግዚኦ 'O Lord' (vocative). ትዜከረነ 'you remembered us' (ዘከረ, with an unusual prefix (?)); በሣህልከ 'in-mercy-your'. ግዱፋን 'outcasts, abandoned' (?) and እለ መነንከ ሕዝብ 'whom you ... from a people' (?), both uncertain. ከመ እርአያ ለማኅደርከ 'that I see (her) your dwelling' (ማኅደር 'dwelling'; ለ- marks the object). ንጽሕት 'pure'. Zion 'in the heavens' is the heavenly archetype of the Ark, as in the Zion theology. Echoes Psalm 132 (the Lord's dwelling).

sentences.t: ወምንተኑ ፡ ነዐስዮ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በእንተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ ለነ ፡ ሠናያተ ፡ እንዘወኢምንትኒበኀቤሁ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ወስብሐተ ፤
sentences.l: And-what-then shall-we-repay to-God for all that-he-did for-us good-things, while and-nothing-at-all with-him glory and-praise
sentences.i: And what can we repay to God for all the good things he has done for us, when we have nothing at all to bring to him, no glory or praise?
sentences.n: ምንተኑ 'what then?' (ምንት + -ኑ). ነዐስዮ 'we shall repay him' (ዐሰየ 'repay, requite'); compare Psalm 116:12 (115:12 in the Septuagint): 'What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits?' ኵሉ ዘገብረ ለነ 'all that he did for us'; ሠናያተ 'good things' (plural). Fused in print: እንዘወኢምንትኒበኀቤሁ = እንዘ 'while' + ወኢምንትኒ 'and nothing at all' + በኀቤሁ 'with him'. The phrase is elliptical: nothing of glory or praise (is) ours to bring (?); ክብረ ወስብሐተ is accusative.

sentences.t: ከለለነ ፡ በጸጋሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ናእምር ፡ በምድር ፡ ስብሐቲሁ ፡ ወንግነይ ፡ ኵልነ ፡ ለዕበየ ፡ ዚአሁ ፤
sentences.l: He-covered-us by-his-grace that we-know on-earth his-glories, and-let-us-praise all-of-us the-greatness of-him
sentences.i: He has sheltered us by his grace, that we may know his glories on the earth, and may we all praise his greatness.
sentences.n: ከለለነ 'he covered / sheltered us' (ከለለ + -ነ). በጸጋሁ 'by-his-grace'. ከመ ናእምር 'that we know' (subjunctive). ስብሐቲሁ 'his glories' (plural with -ሁ). ንግነይ 'let us bow / serve / praise' (ገነየ, here jussive), ኵልነ 'all of us'. ለዕበየ ዚአሁ 'to the greatness of him' (ዕበይ 'greatness' + ዚአሁ 'his'); ለ- marks the object of ንግነይ. Praise-language of the psalms.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኄር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለኅሩያኒሁ ፡ ወሎቱ ፡ ስብሐት ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዓለ ፡ ም ።
sentences.l: For good he for-his-chosen-ones, and-to-him glory until for-ever
sentences.i: For he is good to his chosen ones, and to him be glory for ever.
sentences.n: ኄር 'good' is the predicate (Psalm 136:1 'for he is good'). ለኅሩያኒሁ 'to-his-chosen-ones' (ኅሩይ 'chosen', plural ኅሩያን, with -ሁ and an extra -ኒ). ወሎቱ ስብሐት 'and to-him glory', the closing doxology. ለዓለ ም is printed with a space inside the word ('for ever'), so it is divided in the source: a printing break, kept as printed. The speech begun in unit 8 seems to end here.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ያንፈርዕፅ ፡ ከመ ፡ ማሕስአ ፡ በግዕ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ሐርጌ ፡ ጽጉበ ፡ ሐሊበ ፡ እሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-rose the-king while he-leaps like ማሕስአ (?) of-sheep and-like ሐርጌ (?) fat suckling-of its-mother
sentences.i: The king rose, leaping like a young lamb (?) and like a fat calf (?) suckling at its mother.
sentences.n: ተንሥአ 'rose' (ተንሥአ). እንዘ ያንፈርዕፅ 'while he leaps / skips' (እንዘ + imperfect), the verb is አንፈርዕፀ 'leap, jump about'. ማሕስአ is uncertain (?): I read it as some young animal of the flock, joined with በግዕ 'sheep'. ሐርጌ is also unknown to me (?): the parallel 'fat, suckling' (ጽጉበ 'fat, well-fed', ሐሊበ 'sucking') suggests a calf or kid. Compare Psalm 114:4 (the mountains skipped like rams) and Malachi 4:2 (calves from the stall), by general echo only.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: As joy-of David father-of his-father before Ark-of law-of to-God
sentences.i: As David, the father of his father, rejoiced before the Ark of the law of God;
sentences.n: በከመ 'just as'. ፍሥሓ ዳዊት 'joy-of David' (construct): David dancing before the Ark when it was brought up to Jerusalem (2 Samuel 6:14–16). አበ አቡሁ 'father-of his-father' makes David the grandfather of the speaker's king: Menelik's father is Solomon, Solomon's father David, so the king is Menelik and the new dancer is also called David (see unit 15). በቅድመ 'before'.

sentences.t: አጽሐሰ ፡ በእገሪሁ ፡ ወተሐሠየ ፡ በልቡ ፡ ወተሀለለ ፡ በአፉሁ ።
sentences.l: He-danced (?) with-his-feet and-he-rejoiced in-his-heart and-he-praised with-his-mouth
sentences.i: He danced (?) with his feet, rejoiced in his heart, and praised with his mouth.
sentences.n: Three verbs, each with a body-part phrase: አጽሐሰ በእገሪሁ is uncertain (?): I read 'danced / stamped (?) with his feet' (እግር 'foot', plural እገር); ተሐሠየ 'rejoiced' (ተሐሠየ) በልቡ 'in his heart'; ተሀለለ 'sang praise' (ተሀለለ, Psalm-language) በአፉሁ 'with his mouth'. The rhythm echoes David's dancing and praise before the Ark.

sentences.t: ወምንተ ፡ እብል ፡ ሚመጠነ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ወሐሤት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ትዕይንተ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፤
sentences.l: And-what shall-I-say how-great joy and-delight among procession-of king-of Ethiopia
sentences.i: And what shall I say of the greatness of the joy and delight in the company of the king of Ethiopia?
sentences.n: ወምንተ እብል 'and what shall I say?' is a narrator's question, a stock turn. ሚመጠነ 'how great' (ሚ- 'what' + መጠን 'measure'). ፍሥሓ ወሐሤት 'joy and delight' (a pair). ትዕይንተ is the accusative/construct of ትዕይንት 'procession, array, company' (?), here 'the king's company'. ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ 'king-of Ethiopia' (construct); ንጉሠ with -ሠ spelling.

sentences.t: ይነግሮ ፡ ፩ ፡ ለካልኡ ፡ ወያንፈርዕፁ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጣዕዋ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወይጠፍሑ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ወያነክሩ ፡ ወይሰፍሑ ፡ እደዊሆሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ በገጾሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወያአኵትዎ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ በአልባቢሆሙ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: He-tells one to-his-other, and-they-leap all-of-them like ጣዕዋ (?) ox, and-they-stretch their-hands and-they-marvel (?) and-they-spread their-hands into heaven and-they-bow with-their-faces into earth and-they-thank God in-their-hearts
sentences.i: One tells another, and they all leap like a ጣዕዋ (?) ox, and stretch out their hands, and wonder (?), and spread their hands toward heaven, and bow with their faces to the ground, and give thanks to God in their hearts.
sentences.n: ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'he tells (it) one to-his-other' (፩ is the numeral 'one'; ካልእ 'other', ለ- 'to'). ወያንፈርዕፁ 'and they leap' (plural of the verb in unit 19). ጣዕዋ is unknown to me (?); ላህም 'ox, cow'. ይጠፍሑ 'they stretch / spread' (ጠፍሐ); ያነክሩ is uncertain (?): 'they marvel / act strangely (?)'; ይሰፍሑ 'they spread (their hands)'. ይሰግዱ 'they bow' (ሰገደ) በገጾሙ 'with their faces'. ያአኵትዎ 'they give thanks to him' (አአኰተ + -ኦ) ለእግዚኣብሔር, ለ- marks the object again. በአልባቢሆሙ 'in their hearts' (plural of ልብ, with -ሆሙ). The final ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ is the chapter-end mark and belongs to the last unit.
